shadows.purpose: Menus, dialogs and the details sheet only.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover, selection and panel open or close. Reduced motion: instant.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Send, Save agent, New agent. One per region.

components.name: Conversation Row
components.description: One agent, or Everyone, in the conversation list.

components.name: Composer
components.description: The message box, pinned to the bottom of the conversation.

keyCharacteristics: Three panes on wide screens, two on medium, one at a time on phones.
Flat tonal layers: ink, then panel, then raised. No decorative shadows.
One accent (periwinkle) for actions, focus and links only.
One hue per agent, used only on its avatar.
Plain-text labels. No icons as decoration, no emoji.
Responsive by structure, not by fluid type.

rules.name: The Rationed Accent Rule
rules.body: Periwinkle covers 10% or less of any screen. If two periwinkle things compete, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The One Hue Per Agent Rule
rules.body: An agent is the same colour in the list, in the thread, in the details panel and in the Agent Office. A second palette for the same agent is a bug.

rules.name: The Five Sizes Rule
rules.body: Only 12, 13, 14, 16 and 20px exist. Half-pixel sizes (11.5, 12.5, 13.5) and 10 or 11px text are prohibited.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: Coloured shadows, glows and halos are prohibited. If something glows, it is decoration.
